Class PolityBordersRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.renderers.PolityBordersRenderer
public class PolityBordersRenderer extends Object
Thematic Layer Renderer for political sovereignty, institutional maturity, Asabiyyah solidarity, and borders.

Extracted from H3MapCanvas to decouple the core canvas rendering loop and camera projection from thematic domain coloring, ensuring modularity, high maintainability, and clean SRP.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
